data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of $8.4m (2014: favourable run off deviation of $169.1m) was experienced during the year in respect of various lines of business. Most significantly releases within aviation ($7.2m), marine ($5.4m), liability ($10.7m) where offset by increases in reinsurance ($20.2m). This is mainly due to a reduction in the ultimate loss estimates.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a small favourable prior-accident-year run-off of $8.4m in 2015, driven by reductions in ultimate loss estimates (favourable development) primarily in Aviation, Marine and Casualty lines. These releases were largely offset by increases related to reinsurance, leaving an overall prior-year release. The movement is reported in the Movement in Prior Year's Provision note and is described as being due mainly to reductions in ultimate loss estimates.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure of $8.4m is stated in the Movement in Prior Year's Provision note but the report does not explicitly label this amount as gross (insurance liabilities) vs net (after reinsurance). The note language and subsidiary line items (releases by LOB and an 'increase in reinsurance') suggest the $8.4m is a net prior year release; no explicit gross prior-year movement figure was provided. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet liabilities (Claims outstanding, comparative column). All monetary amounts reported in native currency (USD).
